verdicts.reason: A is unusable: the background covers only a centre strip with white bars on both sides, and the headline ('BSERVATORY'), the details and the 'FREE ENTRY' line are all cut off at the left edge, so the message is lost. B has the same white side bars and clips the 'O' of the headline, its details text is tiny and runs over the satellite and dome, and the 'FREE ENTRY' line is promoted above the details. Still, B keeps most of the copy readable and in one group, so it is the less bad of the two.
